saySample.text: You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 30s telling A man, maybe 60s about A person, maybe 60s, with deep-set eyes. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
💧 A person, maybe 60s, with deep-set eyes returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 A person, maybe 30s returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A person, maybe 60s, with a wiry build returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a nervous tic returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 50s returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 20s returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 50s returns with water: +3 clean.

"Hey." A person, maybe 60s, with deep-set eyes settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 60s, with deep-set eyes.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A woman, maybe 60s paces the hall, restless, then sits. Then paces.
A person, maybe 30s: "The large tree, compound leaves, round green husks that smell citrus-pine, dark furrowed bark patch is fruiting again. Somebody should get out there."
Ostap and Adrian lingered over the fire together.
Emma and Ostap lingered over the fire together.
Liam and Ostap lingered over the fire together.
📓 Journal: the person in their 60s, with a wiry build taught the woman in her 20s Herbal Medicine.
— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
👀 the person in their 60s, with deep-set eyes says they want to belong somewhere. But they keep doing the exact thing someone who wants something else would do — and going quiet when anyone notices.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A person, maybe 60s, with deep-set eyes).
Imke Albrecht reads the sky: clear tomorrow, cold.
A man, maybe 40s, with a shaved head will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You step into the Haven hall.
📋 A man, maybe 40s, with a shaved head — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
📋 A person, maybe 60s, with deep-set eyes — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
(Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
"Ostap," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Ostap." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Ostap).
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 60s speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
"Nora," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Nora." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Nora).
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 20s speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
"Emma," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Emma." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Emma).
You eat Dried meat and Trail mix (1400 kcal).
It's barely dawn. The day is yours — sleep is for later.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 30s says. (Trust too low.)

🌿 A man, maybe 40s, with a shaved head checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~7 days of fresh on hand… leaves the fish nets standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪵 A man, maybe 40s, with a shaved head hauls back 6 wood. The pile grows. (16 logs now.)
💧 A person, maybe 60s, with deep-set eyes returns with 9L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
A person, maybe 60s, with deep-set eyes heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
A man, maybe 40s, with a shaved head heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going."
